jobs.description:
Are you a born problem solver with a passion for customer satisfaction? Do you want to work in an international environment where no day is the same? Then we have the perfect challenge for you! At Volvo, they are looking for an enthusiastic customer service representative to join their Central-East team and contribute to their mission of getting vehicles back on the road quickly and efficiently. Your duties: 

 
• Provide first line support for international breakdowns: Wherever our customers are in Europe, you will be there to help them and address their concerns. 
 

 
• Maintain regular contact with dealers and customers: So that everyone is always informed about the progress of repairs. 
 

 
• Working together in a dedicated team: You will be part of a team that is committed 24/7 to providing our customers with the best possible support. 
 Keywords: customer support advisor, customer service, call agent, customer service representative
Bachelor thinking level. Fluent in English + Czech + German (minimum B2 level). 

Flexible in working hours: Working in a full-time system is not a problem for you; rather, you enjoy the variety. Driving license B: You must be able to come to the company independently.

Our client, an international organisation active in technical services and customer support, is undergoing a major digital transformation across its European operations. To support this journey, they are looking for an experienced Business Analyst & Transformation Project Lead .

In this key position within the organization , you will drive business improvement initiatives, manage strategic projects, and act as the link between operational teams and IT.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Programme Management

• Manage a portfolio of business transformation and IT-related projects.
• Define priorities, timelines, budgets, and project deliverables.
• Coordinate stakeholders and ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Identify and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.
Business Process Improvement

• Analyse existing business processes and identify opportunities for optimisation.
• Drive initiatives focused on standardisation, automation, and digitalisation.
• Support the development of scalable and efficient operational practices.
Requirements Analysis

• Gather, analyse, and document business requirements.
• Translate operational and commercial needs into clear functional specifications.
• Ensure requirements are understood by technical teams and external partners.
• Solution Development
Collaborate closely with IT and business systems teams.

• Evaluate and implement solutions that support both current and future business needs.
• Ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.
Commercial & Supplier Management

• Support and lead commercial initiatives related to projects and business improvements.
• Manage relationships with external suppliers and service providers.
• Participate in contract discussions and monitor project budgets and performance.
 

Stakeholder Management

• Act as the primary contact between business operations and IT teams
• Build strong relationships across departments and facilitate effective communication.
• Ensure business priorities are clearly understood and aligned.

• Has proven experience managing business transformation projects and programmes.
• Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Is comfortable working with data and translating insights into actionable recommendations.
• Possesses strong commercial awareness and can assess the business impact of decisions.
• Has experience gathering and documenting business requirements.
• Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Builds strong working relationships and influences stakeholders at different levels.
• Thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Has experience working with IT, ERP, CRM, or other business systems teams.
• Is fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch and/or French  is considered an asset.

Are you a night owl with a talent for solving technical challenges?

Do you thrive in a modern production environment where teamwork and quality are top priorities? Then this is the opportunity for you!

Your role

As a Maintenance Technician in the fixed night shift, you are essential to our production process. You ensure that machines operate at their best, perform preventive maintenance, and resolve malfunctions quickly and effectively. With your technical skills and problem-solving mindset, you keep the production running even while the world sleeps.

What will you do?

• Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance on machines and installations.
• Detect, analyze, and fix malfunctions (primarily electrical, ideally with mechanical expertise).
• Start up and optimize production lines.
• Actively contribute to improving the reliability and efficiency of the equipment.
• Collaborate with a team and report to the technical service manager.
Work schedule

• 2 workdays (2 x 7.36 hours) and 2 weekend days (2 x 11 hours), offering a steady yet varied schedule.
 

 

• A technical degree or relevant experience in a production environment.
• Broad technical knowledge of mechanics, electricity, and pneumatics; PLC knowledge is a plus.
• A flexible, positive attitude and strong problem-solving skills.
• A team player who is eager to learn and improve.
• Fluency in Dutch or English.

jobs.occupation: Store Assistant / Sales Associate – Christmas Shop | Bruges | Full-Time
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working in a welcoming retail environment and love the magic of Christmas? Do you enjoy helping customers find the perfect decorations for the holiday season?

For a unique Christmas store in the heart of Bruges, we are looking for an enthusiastic Store Assistant / Sales Associate who will help customers bring the Christmas spirit into their homes.

What will you do?
As a Sales Associate, you will be the face of the store and ensure that every customer enjoys a warm and pleasant shopping experience.

Your responsibilities include:

• Welcoming and assisting customers in a friendly manner
• Advising customers on Christmas decorations, ornaments, gifts and seasonal products
• Maintaining an attractive and organized store presentation
• Restocking shelves and keeping the store clean and tidy
• Processing payments and handling cash register duties
• Assisting with deliveries and unpacking new merchandise

• You enjoy working with customers and providing excellent service
• You are willing to work weekends on a rotating schedule
• Previous retail or sales experience is an advantage
• You speak Spanish, Dutch or English fluently
• In addition to your strongest language, you can communicate at a basic level in at least one of the other languages
• You enjoy working in an international environment with tourists and visitors from different countries
• You are enthusiastic, reliable and enjoy working as part of a team

A strong financial profile with people management skills and a passion for process optimisation? As an AP Manager at Lotus Bakeries, you will have the opportunity to take on a key role within an international environment in Lembeke.

In this versatile role, you will combine people management with operational responsibility and process optimisation. You will have the freedom to take initiative, implement improvements and contribute to building efficient and future-proof Accounts Payable processes.

 

 

 

 

 

 

Your responsibilities:

As an AP Manager, you will be responsible for Accounts Payable services across multiple entities and countries.

• Lead, coach and develop the AP team (9 people), allocate workloads and ensure efficient operations and continuity.
• Coordinate the entire AP flow, from invoice receipt, processing and approval through to payments and supplier management, while ensuring process quality and timely execution.
• Monitor KPIs and SLAs, analyse workload and performance, and take action where necessary to further improve service delivery.
• Act as the first point of contact for complex AP matters and work closely with Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Treasury and external stakeholders.
• Ensure compliance with accounting policies, tax and legal requirements, as well as internal controls, and support internal and external audits.
• Analyse AP and cash management processes, including payment timing, DPO and cash discounts, and initiate concrete improvements.
• Identify opportunities for automation and process optimisation and contribute to finance transformation and system projects, such as SAP, VIM and Concur.
 

 

Your profile:

• You hold a Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or an equivalent field, combined with at least 5 years of relevant experience in AP or Accounting, preferably within an international or shared services environment.
• You have experience in people management and know how to coach, motivate and further develop a team.
• You have strong knowledge of AP accounting, VAT and invoice-to-pay processes, as well as experience with ERP systems; knowledge of SAP and VIM is a plus.
• You are analytical and KPI-driven, with strong knowledge of MS Excel and standard Office tools.
• You are fluent in Dutch and English; knowledge of French is a plus.
• You are organised, proactive and solution-oriented, with the ability to set priorities effectively in a dynamic FMCG environment.
• You are a strong communicator with a stakeholder-oriented mindset and identify with values such as team spirit, open dialogue and passion.

As a Line Supervisor 2-shifts, you are the key figure in the packaging department. You lead a motivated team and ensure that the machines perform optimally and the final products leave the facility perfectly packaged. You work closely with the production manager and planning department in a clean, high-tech, and fast-paced work environment where no two days are the same.

In the role of Line Supervisor 2-shifts, you carry the responsibility for the entire packaging process. Your concrete tasks include:

• Process Monitoring: You correctly start up and guide the packaging process from A to Z to guarantee an efficient flow.
• Team Leadership: You coordinate, motivate, and guide the team on the packaging floor.
• Quality & Hygiene: You ensure strict compliance with quality standards and hygiene regulations within the food sector.
• Problem Solving: You quickly resolve operational issues and malfunctions, and continuously look for process optimizations.
• Reporting: You report directly to the production manager regarding progress, results, and any bottlenecks.
• Communication & Planning: You check packaging orders and streamline communication between production planning and the storage of the finished product.
• Digitalization: You assist with the further rollout and everyday use of the MES & ERP systems on the packaging floor.
To be successful as a Line Supervisor 2-shifts or experienced packaging team leader, you recognize yourself in the following profile:

• Experience: You have experience within a production environment, ideally in the food industry.
• Leadership & Insight: You have technical insight and possess the natural ability to manage and motivate an operational team.
• Flexibility: You are a real go-getter with a flexible mindset who is happy to work in a fixed 2-shift system.
• Communication: You have a good command of the English language (for communication on the work floor).
• IT Skills: You have good computer skills and quickly pick up new software (such as ERP or MES).

Are you an experienced orderpicker who speaks fluent English or Dutch and wants to work in a 2 shift system in Westerlo? At DSV you will start immediately in a modern warehouse environment where a team of logistics experts shapes the future of transport and distribution every day. The atmosphere in the department is energetic and collaborative, making you start your workday with great enthusiasm. As a specialized orderpicker in this dynamic distribution center you play a key role in the logistical process, ensuring that the cosmetic products of Estee Lauder reach their destination smoothly. The variety as a warehouse worker and logistics employee ensures that no two days are the same.

VG599/BUOSAP

• You possess a stable first experience as an orderpicker in a warehouse environment.
• You speak and understand fluent English or Dutch to follow safety instructions accurately.
• You are willing to work in a flexible 2 shift system with an early shift and a late shift.
• You have no fear of heights and are willing to operate an orderpicktruck at heights up to 8 meters.
• You are physically fit and looking for a long term fulltime job with a quick start.

• You ensure the accurate scanning and sorting of various goods on pallets.
• You pick goods based on customer orders and utilize a digital hand scanner efficiently.
• You check incoming goods for quality and provide them with the correct labels.
• You safely operate an orderpicktruck at heights to prepare customer orders.
• You actively assist with the loading and unloading of trucks in the warehouse.
• You monitor general tidiness and strictly adhere to the strict safety rules on the work floor at all times.

As an Order Picker working in our dynamic 2-shift system, you'll be right in the heart of the action, responsible for:

• Scanning and sorting goods on pallets like a logistics whiz.
• Getting those orders prepped and ready to roll out.
• Ensuring every item is perfectly labeled and passes our top-notch quality checks.
• Becoming a master of the hand scanner - your essential sidekick!
• Tackling loading and unloading tasks with confidence.
• Conquering heights (up to 8 meters!) on our man-up equipment - it's your mission control to efficient order picking!
Excited to jump in and make a real impact? Got questions? Don't hesitate to ask!

Send an email to talent.2591@tempo-team.be or call 014 80 00 15! 

VG599/BUOSAP

Are You the Awesome orderpicker we're looking for?

• You thrive in a fast-paced job with lots of variety in a clean and safe setting.
• You're not afraid of a bit of physical work - bring it on!
• You're looking for a full-time gig with long-term prospects.
• You're ready to dive in and start ASAP!
• Working in a 2-shift system (early/late) fits your lifestyle.
• You have previous experience working in a warehouse

- scanning and sorting goods on pallets

- preparing orders 

- labeling goods and checking for quality

As a future butcher / deboner of pork meat, you will work on different lines with tasks such as cutting shoulders, bellies, and ribs.

We are looking for ambitious and eager-to-learn individuals who can start early (start at 4.55 AM) and are flexible in their schedules depending on the season.

Are you ready for a challenging career in the FAB Engineering team? Would you like to work with the most high-tech devices? Then read on quickly!

As an Equipment Maintenance Engineer, you'll start your journey in the esteemed FAB Engineering team:

• You'll get hands-on experience with the high-tech process equipment in our cleanroom. No need to be an expert from day one – we'll give you the time to thoroughly understand these cutting-edge tools. The team takes pride in maintaining and fine-tuning some of the most advanced equipment globally. You'll even get a chance to work with first versions and prototypes, which is pretty exciting!
• You will work closely with equipment manufacturers and other process engineers, so you'll be collaborating with a diverse group of experts.
• You’ll be part of the FAB Engineering team that consists of over 100 talented individuals with whom you will form the beating heart of our research institute. Specializing in nano-electronics, your work will contribute to technological solutions in various fields like healthcare and energy.

• You hold a Master's degree in Industrial Science with a focus on Electromechanics or Mechanics, or you have acquired equivalent technical experience. If you're just starting out, that's perfectly fine! We welcome motivated beginners who are eager to launch their careers.
• You are genuinely passionate about technology and equipment, and you are not afraid to work hands-on. Your technical knowledge of pneumatics, pumps, motors, electronics, and (electro)mechanics is a valuable asset.
• We highly appreciate your collaborative spirit, while also trusting your ability to proactively plan and organize your work on your own.
• You have a very good knowledge of English.
You will work in a shift regime: early - late (6u-14u & 14u-22u) and 1 weekend every 3 weeks

What will you do?

What does your day look like as a truck driver with a Moffett?

  • You start early in the morning (between 5 AM and 6 AM) from our base in Deinze. Loading is not necessary – your truck is already prepared the night before. You follow a fixed route for a regular customer. On average, you make 4 to 6 deliveries per day across the Benelux.
  • You are responsible for unloading the goods yourself using the Moffett forklift attached to your truck. Our dispatch team is always ready to support you in case of questions, delays, or unexpected situations.
  • Finished with your deliveries? Then you drive back to Deinze – job done!

Interested?
Send your CV to Eeklo@absolutejobs.be

What do we expect from you?

  • You're not afraid to roll up your sleeves and get things done
  • Physical work is part of the job for you – not an obstacle
  • You have your own transportation, as the truck stays on our premises
  • You can communicate fluently in Dutch, French, or English
  • You're a team player who’s ready to help out where needed
  • You keep your truck and trailer clean and tidy
  • You maintain clear communication with dispatch and other departments

jobs.occupation: Talencia Consulting - SAP FICO Functional Analyst
jobs.description:
Talencia is looking for a SAP FICO Functional Analyst for one of its clients.

Location : Brussels periphery

Start date : ASAP

Duration : Permanent (Open-Ended Contract, CDI)

Our client is a well-established retail organization looking for a SAP FICO Functional Analyst to join its internal team and take an active role in the day-to-day management and evolution of their SAP landscape.
Description 

• Act as a functional reference for SAP, with a strong focus on FICO.

• Provide day-to-day functional support and analyse incidents and business requirements.

• Translate business needs into functional SAP solutions and specifications.

• Understand end-to-end processes including purchasing, order flows, warehouse operations and Finance.

• Analyse interactions between SAP and external applications, interfaces and third-party systems.

• Work closely with developers and technical teams, understanding technical specifications and code without being a developer yourself.

• Participate in functional analysis, testing and implementation of new solutions.

• Gradually take ownership of existing knowledge through close collaboration and knowledge transfer from experienced SAP professionals.

You are a SAP professional with a strong functional mindset, capable of understanding both business processes and their technical environment. Along, you bring:

• 5+ years of SAP experience.

• Strong knowledge of SAP FICO.

• Experience as a SAP Functional Analyst, SAP Business Analyst, SAP Consultant, Application Consultant or similar.

• A good understanding of end-to-end SAP processes and integrations.

• The ability to turn business requirements into practical functional solutions.

• Enough technical understanding to communicate effectively with developers and understand interfaces and system interactions.

• A working knowledge of English, Dutch and French
